title: Soybean oil-derived, non-isocyanate polyurethane–TiO2 nanocomposites with enhanced thermal, mechanical, hydrophobic and antimicrobial properties
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,1434-1447
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00587B, Paper

Jaydip D. Bhaliya, S. N. Raju Kutcherlapati, Nikhil Dhore, Neelambaram Punugupati, Kavya Lekha Sunkara, Sunil Misra, Shivam Shailesh Kumar Joshi
Non-isocyanate polyurethane nanocomposites from soybean oil and TiO2 exhibit improved thermal stability, mechanical strength, hydrophobicity, and antimicrobial properties, highlighting eco-friendly material innovation.
